objective: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

description: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
You return to the Undercity, <name>. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
completion: Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. We have great things to discuss, <name>. Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.
